class.name: WorldSimulation
class.brief_description: Tick root for T.R.A.U.M.A. world simulation.
class.description: Owns WorldState double-buffer, drives tick order Perception → Squad → Agent → Faction → World mutation → Director (next-tick). Call tick(delta) from _physics_process only; respects Jolt separate thread. Follows SConstruct doc gen pattern.

method.name: tick
method.description: Advance one simulation tick. Advances tick_count and elapsed_time, updates agents and world state.

method.name: get_agent_count
method.description: Return number of agents in the simulation.

signal.name: tick_completed
signal.description: Emitted after each tick with the new elapsed_time.
